#!/bin/bash
# The diagnostic of the inserts (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index,
# "Pasada de diagnóstico del insert", its amendments 1 and 2): every pass on
# an APFS clone of its own of the index, removed after the pass; the 10M
# index the night left is never opened. First the 100k index is grown, with
# the control binary; then the passes at 100k and at 10M. Timed: the marker,
# the wait for an idle machine, and run under caffeinate -i -s. The binaries
# are built before (diag.test from local/diag-insert, m2.test from 44c35ee9b9
# with the same harness); nothing here builds until the passes are over.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
X=$S/diag
D=$HOME/Documents/datasets/wikidpr-10m-e5-inplace.bin
P=adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge

printf 'diagnostic of the inserts at 100k and at 10M (diag/chain.sh), timed, since %s for about two hours and a half; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

# The 100k index: the first 100 000 rows of the dataset, 8 callers.
mkdir -p $X/i100k
date "+== %H:%M:%S grow 100k"
(cd $X/m2/$P && PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$X/i100k/index PE_OUT=$X/i100k/grow.json PE_ROWS=100000 PE_CALLERS=8 \
  PE_STRETCH=30 PE_MINFREE=4 $X/m2.test -test.run '^TestNightGrow$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $X/i100k/grow.log 2>&1)
echo "grow 100k exit $?"

# run <size> <name> <binary> <test> <sample 0|1> [NAME=value ...]
run() {
  local size=$1 name=$2 bin=$3 test=$4 sample=$5
  shift 5
  local C=$X/runs/$size/$name
  local tree=$X/src
  [ $bin = m2 ] && tree=$X/m2
  mkdir -p $C
  if [ $size = 100k ]; then
    cp -c -R $X/i100k/index $C/index || exit 3
    # Warm: every file of the clone read once before the index opens.
    find $C/index -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
    set -- PE_ROWS=100000 "$@"
  else
    cp -c -R $S/grow10m/index $C/index || exit 3
    # The store read once (7 GB); the vectors (30.7 GB) do not fit in the
    # file cache next to it, and stay as cold as a new clone is.
    find $C/index/lsm -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
  fi
  date "+== %H:%M:%S $size $name: $bin $test $*"
  (cd $tree/$P && exec env PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$C/index PE_OUT=$C/result.json "$@" \
    $X/$bin.test -test.run "^$test\$" -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $C/run.log 2>&1) &
  local pid=$!
  python3 -I -B $X/monitor.py $pid $C/monitor.jsonl 2 > $C/monitor.err 2>&1 &
  local mon=$!
  if [ $sample = 1 ]; then
    (
      while [ ! -e $C/result.json.started ] && ps -p $pid > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.2; done
      sleep 3
      date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S start" > $C/sample.log
      /usr/bin/sample $pid 10 1 -file $C/sample.txt >> $C/sample.out 2>&1
      date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S end exit $?" >> $C/sample.log
    ) &
  fi
  wait $pid
  echo "$size $name exit $?"
  wait
  df -k $X | tail -n 1 | awk '{print "free after the pass, before removing its clone: " int($4/1048576) " GiB"}'
  # The clone of a pass is not kept: its results are.
  find /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/diag/runs -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
}

passes() {
  local size=$1
  # The control: m2 as it is, the diagnostic binary with its clocks off, and with them on.
  run $size control-m2 m2 TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8
  run $size control-diag-off diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_CLOCKS=0
  run $size control-diag-on diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8
  # The phases, twice, the second in the opposite order.
  for c in 1 2 4 8; do run $size phases-c$c-a diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=$c; done
  for c in 8 4 2 1; do run $size phases-c$c-b diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=$c; done
  run $size counters-c8 diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_WORK=1
  run $size queries-c8 diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_KIND=queries PE_N=1000 PE_EVERY=200
  [ $size = 100k ] && run $size fresh-c8 diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_KIND=fresh
  run $size nocompaction-c8 diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_COMPACTION=0
  run $size search-t1 diag TestDiagSearch 0 PE_THREADS=1
  run $size search-t8 diag TestDiagSearch 0 PE_THREADS=8
  run $size profile-c1 diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=1 PE_CPUPROFILE=$X/runs/$size/profile-c1/cpu.prof
  run $size profile-c8 diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_CPUPROFILE=$X/runs/$size/profile-c8/cpu.prof
  run $size sample-c8 diag TestDiagInserts 1 PE_CALLERS=8
  run $size trace-c8 diag TestDiagInserts 0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_TRACE=$X/runs/$size/trace-c8/trace.out
}

passes 100k
passes 10m
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S passes done" | tee $X/end.txt
pmset -g log 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+ \+[0-9]+ (Sleep|Wake|DarkWake)' | tail -n 20 > $X/pmset-sleep-wake.txt
echo "pmset exit $?"
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
